title: Ethiopian Ful (Ful Medames) Recipe with Berbere
desc: Ethiopian ful: fava beans simmered with berbere and finished with tasty garnishes. An inexpensive, hearty vegetarian dish for breakfast or dinner.

title: How to Cook Green Beans: Microwave, Then Roast
desc: The trick to green beans with real caramelized spots: microwave them first, then roast or pan-sear. Includes how long to microwave green beans.

title: Vegetarian Indian Tacos Recipe (Navajo Fry Bread)
desc: Make Indian tacos with homemade Navajo fry bread and a spicy vegetarian topping, plus the history of this iconic Native American food.

title: Pear-Caramel Ice Cream from The Perfect Scoop (by David Lebovitz) - Recipe and Cookbook Review
desc: Pear-caramel ice cream from David Lebovitz's The Perfect Scoop, with a review of the cookbook.

title: Pupusas de Queso: Salvadoran Cheese-Filled Tortillas
desc: How to make pupusas de queso, El Salvador's national dish: corn masa stuffed with cheese, flattened and cooked on a griddle. A vegetarian recipe.

title: Beet and Tomato Salad with Feta and Mint
desc: An easy summer salad of fresh tomatoes and beets with feta and mint. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Vietnamese Green Mango Salad Recipe
desc: A vegetarian Vietnamese green mango salad with bright, bold flavors. Easy to make with a handful of fresh ingredients.

title: Turkish Chickpea and Potato Stew with Baharat
desc: Recipe for a vegetarian stew of chickpeas and potatoes flavored with Turkish baharat. Gluten-free and optionally vegan.

title: Zucchini and Chickpea Tagine
desc: Zucchini and chickpea tagine recipe, plus what a tagine is: the Moroccan clay pot and the slow-braised dishes cooked in it.

title: Pretzel Ice Cream Recipe (Homemade, Salty-Sweet)
desc: Homemade pretzel ice cream with a custard base infused with toasted pretzel flavor, plus crunchy pretzel pieces. A salty-sweet scoop worth the effort.

title: How to Cook Watermelon: Seared Watermelon Recipe
desc: Yes, you can cook watermelon. Sear it for crisp edges and a concentrated flavor, served with dehydrated corn and herb flowers in this modernist vegetarian dish.

title: Methi Dal: Indian Lentil Soup with Fenugreek
desc: A simple, delicious Indian red lentil soup with fresh fenugreek (methi). Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free.

title: Quick Apple Kimchi Recipe (Green Apple Kimchi)
desc: A quick green apple \"kimchi\" with the crunch and spice of the classic, made much faster. An easy vegetarian side dish.

title: Thick & Cakey Chocolate Chip Cookies (with Sea Salt)
desc: A recipe for thick, cakey chocolate chip cookies with a hint of sea salt and high-quality chocolate.

title: Homemade Rye Crackers Recipe (Caraway)
desc: Crisp homemade rye crackers with caraway seeds, easy to make and great with cheese or spreads.

title: Persian Baked Zucchini
desc: Recipe for a vegetarian side dish of baked zucchini with herbs

title: Vegetarian Cowboy Beans (Frijoles Charros) Recipe
desc: Vegetarian frijoles charros, Mexican cowboy beans, flavored with smoked onions instead of meat. Vegan-friendly.

title: Vietnamese Cabbage, Tofu and Herb Salad - Gói Bắp Cải Dậu Phụ
desc: Vietnamese cabbage, tofu and herb salad, inspired by a dish at Seattle's Ba Bar. Bright, fresh and vegetarian.

title: Italian Plum Upside Down Cake
desc: Italian plum upside down cake, a late-summer dessert that shows off warm, ripe Italian plums.

title: Easy Baked Custard Recipe (Silky, Never Grainy)
desc: A simple baked custard in ramekins, with the method that keeps it silky instead of grainy. Easy to flavor many ways.

title: Is Panna Cotta Vegetarian? Banana Panna Cotta Recipe
desc: Traditional panna cotta uses gelatin, so it isn't vegetarian. This caramelized banana and buttermilk version is set with agar instead.

title: Compressed Cucumber (and Cantaloupe) with Shiso Sake
desc: How to make compressed cucumber and cantaloupe, and shiso-infused sake, two modern techniques you can do in a home kitchen.

title: Hazelnut Romesco Sauce (Spanish Red Pepper Sauce)
desc: Romesco, the Spanish red pepper sauce, made with hazelnuts or almonds. A vegetarian recipe you can spoon over vegetables or serve as a dip.

title: Syrian Red Lentil Soup (Shurbat Addes) Recipe
desc: Syrian red lentil soup (shurbat addes), a vegetarian Aleppo-style recipe adapted from Poopa Dweck's Aromas of Aleppo.
